Title: Establishes a Medicaid fraud tip board and Medicaid fraud tip reward fund
Summary: Establishes a Medicaid fraud tip board which shall develop and administer a system offering monetary rewards to certain individuals reporting Medicaid fraud; creates a Medicaid fraud tip reward fund.
LawCode: Add §37, Pub Health L; add §97-bbbbb, St Fin L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law and the state finance law, in relation to establishing a Medicaid fraud tip board and Medicaid fraud tip reward fund
